create_videoclip_model: create a MUGEN video-text CLIP model with pretrained DistilBERT text encoder and S3D video encoder
create_text_encoder: create a DistilBERT-based TextEncoder to encode tokenized text into CLS token hidden state representations
create_video_encoder: create an S3D-based VideoEncoder to encode video tensors into feature embeddings before the classifier layer
create_projection_layer: create a Projection MLP layer to project embeddings to a fixed 256-dimensional output space with dropout
build_attention_mask: build an attention mask tensor from input token IDs by comparing against the padding value
